items.title: The recorded search returned no records
items.whyItMatters: Nothing retrieved means nothing appraised; the leads are unchecked and two are undated, so no certainty can be claimed.
items.opportunity: Retrieve and check the leads by identifier before citing any of them, and answer the local question from local data.

items.title: Conflicting leads on frailty adjustment
items.whyItMatters: One lead finds an association and one finds none after adjusting for frailty; the local decision depends on which is closer to the truth.
items.opportunity: Measure frailty from discharge diagnoses with a score that excludes medicine-related deficits and report both adjusted and unadjusted estimates.

items.title: Confounding by indication
items.whyItMatters: The conditions treated with anticholinergic medicines raise fall risk on their own.
items.opportunity: Adjust for indication groups and add an active-comparator sensitivity analysis for bladder antimuscarinics versus beta-3 agonists.

items.title: Exposure misclassification after 30 days
items.whyItMatters: Without refill data, exposure after the first month is uncertain and would bias a 90-day contrast toward the null.
items.opportunity: Pre-specify a 30-day sensitivity analysis and report both windows.

items.title: Differences by sex, deprivation and discharge destination
items.whyItMatters: Women receive bladder antimuscarinics more often, people in deprived areas carry more multimorbidity, and care home residents differ in exposure and in how falls reach hospital.
items.opportunity: Report estimates by sex, area deprivation quintile and discharge destination without basing policy on subgroups.

errorsFound: The scan reply assigned a certainty label although the recorded search returned no records.
Readmission with a fall is not the same outcome as an injurious fall; a case-control design sampled from readmissions would select on hospital contact.
reevaluation: With nothing retrieved, the gaps favour a cohort of all index discharges from existing local data, with frailty and indication handled explicitly and the leads checked before any is cited.
summary: Five gaps; the empty search, the conflicting leads and confounding by indication are high severity.
